$\begin{array}{|l|} \hline \text{ASSISTANT SUPERINTENDENT OF SCHOOLS} \\ \text{JERSEY CITY BD OF EDUCATION} \\ \text{30 MONTGOMERY STREET} \\ \text{JERSEY CITY , NJ. 07302} \\ \hline \end{array}$

PREVIOUS AGREEMENT EXPIRED
AUGUST 30, 1978

Gentlemen:

We have in our file of collective bargaining agreements a copy of your agreement(s):

JERSEY CITY NJ BD OF EDUCATION TEACHERS WITH EDUCATION ASSOCIATION; NATIONAL NEW JERSEY

Would you please send us a copy of your current agreement--with any supplements (e.g., employee-benefit plans) and wage schedules--renegotiated to replace or to supplement the expired agreement. If your old agreement has continued without change or if it is in reman in force until negotiations are concluded, a notation to this effect on this letter will be appreciated.

I should like to remind you that our agreement file is open for your use, except for material submitted with a restriction on public inspection. You may return this form and your agreement in the enclosed envelope which requires no postage.

Sincerely yours,

*Janet L. Norwood*
JANET L. NORWOOD
Acting Commissioner
